source: Game Concept/narrative/FINAL_SCRIPT.md, SC02. Lines marked "system": true are gameplay feedback, hints or placeholder prompts that are not in the script; review them before release.

intro.speaker: SENA
intro.text: Touch it again and I'll charge you.

intro.speaker: SENA
intro.text: For breaking it while explaining how to improve it.

pump_stuck.text: The handle won't move. Its lever pin has worked loose. The tool basket should have a spare.

basket_take.text: Tavo takes a lever pin from the basket.

basket_empty.text: Nothing else in the basket he needs.

pump_fix.text: The pin slides into place. The handle moves freely.

pump_clear.text: The first pull brings up clear water.

pump_silt.text: The second pull brings up black silt.

whisper.speaker: SENA
whisper.text: I heard our breakfast becoming a long walk.

mera.text: Mera catches Tavo's wrist before he touches the silt. Beneath her sleeve is an old copper burn. On his own wrist, three fine cuts briefly darken. She hides the burn before he can ask.

mera.speaker: MERA
mera.text: Wash your hand. Not in this water.

mera.speaker: SENA
mera.text: Helpful. We were worried it came from the sky.
Mera does not smile. A runner calls them to the cistern.

pump_after.text: The spout still drips black. Not in this water.

inspect_well.speaker: TAVO
inspect_well.text: My mother taught me never to cover a bad repair with fresh plaster.

inspect_bird.speaker: TAVO
inspect_bird.text: Sena keeps improving the same bird. She says making another would let the first one win.

sena_before_pin.speaker: SENA
sena_before_pin.text: The spare pin is in the basket. Where it always is.

sena_before_pump.speaker: SENA
sena_before_pump.text: Pin in, then pump. Try not to improve anything.

sena_after.speaker: SENA
sena_after.text: Go on. Daru will be counting jars without us.

mera_after.speaker: MERA
mera_after.text: The cistern, Tavo. Wash your hand first.

exit_locked.text: Not yet. The pump comes first.
